title: Equation narrow-core overnight convergence

sourceRefs.summary: Run-contract target that explains why this generated contract exists.
Human-approved 26-slice reorder; checkpoint slice 1 completed before this 25-slice successor.

expectedLearning: Whether typed motif invocations eliminate caller-local reimplementation while preserving exact approved animation behavior.
Whether immutable registries plus generated literal dispatch make new equation callers extension-only, exhaustive, and tree-shakable.
Whether stronger invariant owners can replace high-churn count and source-shape tests while reducing verification cost.
allowedWork: Implement the approved 25 remaining slices from the equation narrow-core overnight proposal.
Preserve existing behavior while replacing caller-specific motif, registry, dispatch, loader, compatibility, and duplicate-test authority.
Defer individual callers whose exact visual equivalence cannot be proved, then continue independent deterministic slices.
disallowedWork: Do not approve, tune, or promote the pending log-product visual candidate or any other subjective visual policy.
Do not change public layout, curriculum, user-authored economics files, unrelated untracked documents, or domain-specific graph, code, diagram, Canvas, WebGL, or Graph3D semantics.
Do not create a mutable global registry, side-effect registration, generic visual fallback, universal plugin system, or universal cross-domain compiler.
goal: Make equation motifs executable shared APIs, replace closed core dispatch with typed declarations and generated closure, retire low-value duplicate tests, and behavior-preservingly migrate supported equation callers without promoting pending visual policy.
commitCadence: Commit every independently reversible verified slice with exact path staging and completed Theseus evidence.
stopConditions: Stop on loss of semantic identity, native endpoints, deterministic seek or rewind, interruption, reduced motion, accessibility truth, or shared-clock ownership.
Stop on unexplained bundle-boundary regression, non-tree-shakable eager loading, or unrelated user-owned file changes.
When a caller cannot preserve presentation exactly, leave it on the existing path, record the gap, and continue only independent slices rather than tuning visuals.
Stop if the architecture begins merging equation, graph, code, diagram, Canvas, WebGL, or Graph3D domain compilers.
Stop when the approved slice list is exhausted.

slices.title: Baseline-iteration-economics
slices.summary: Added a stable iteration-economics measurement command, pure diagnostic model and test, and durable baseline. The report establishes exact pre-refactor denominators without turning source shape into permanent policy.

slices.title: Typed-verification-modes
slices.summary: Added typed discovery, contract, promotion, and release verification modes; unknown paths remain fail-broad; function-wrap changes now select semantic preservation plus their own self-contained deterministic visual harness rather than the unrelated linear-equation capture.

slices.title: Preservation-manifest-expansion
slices.summary: Expanded preservation matrix v2 across all 30 equation surfaces with semantic and endpoint fingerprints, renderer capability/adapter/source ownership, shared-clock authority, direct sampler ownership, and deterministic 0/0.5/1 frame fingerprints. Runtime behavior is unchanged.

slices.title: Canonical-vocabulary-and-ids
slices.summary: Added validated nominal MotifId, RecipeId, OperationKind, RendererCapabilityId, and FamilyId vocabulary with versioned namespaces and JSON-boundary guards. Function-wrap reception now carries motif.function-wrap.v1. No runtime choreography changed; the aggregate inference cost ceiling remains separately red and recorded.

slices.title: Motif-invocation-protocol
slices.summary: Added nominal role-complete motif invocations, fail-closed validation and diagnostics, capability-aware renderer-neutral compiled plans, and contract-mode verification routing for domain protocols.

slices.title: Recipe-composition-protocol
slices.summary: Added immutable acyclic recipe phase graphs, sequence and overlap dependencies, compiler-minted recipe authority, normalized shared-clock windows, and history-independent seek, rewind, and interruption sampling.

slices.title: Registry-topology
slices.summary: Added separate immutable registries for semantic operations, recipes, motifs, renderer capabilities, and families, composed through explicitly injected equation packs with no mutable global or side-effect registration.

slices.title: Build-time-registry-validator
slices.summary: Added fail-closed build-time pack validation for operation, recipe, motif, capability, and family closure; exact role compatibility; reciprocal ownership; recipe cycles; and explicit code-generation dispositions.

slices.title: Generated-literal-dispatch
slices.summary: Generated exhaustive operation, recipe, motif, renderer-capability, and lazy-pack dispatch from one validated function-wrap declaration pack using literal dynamic imports and named exports; unknown IDs fail without fallback and live bundle closure remains unchanged.

slices.title: Function-wrap-single-authority
slices.summary: Made motif.function-wrap.v1 the single executable owner of role schema, phase grammar, shared motion profile, and renderer-neutral reception plan. Existing imports are thin identity-preserving re-exports; the generated dispatcher targets the motif definition and no live choreography changed.

slices.title: Native-KaTeX-function-wrap-adapter
slices.summary: Consolidated Native KaTeX function-wrap adaptation behind one capability definition with validated canonical motif input, measured outside-in geometry, direction-aware native settlement, synchronized cohort ownership, and audit certificates. Focused reduced-motion browser coverage passes; an unrelated pre-existing apply-log collision remains recorded and untouched.

slices.title: Canonical-function-wrap-cutover
slices.summary: Canonical x-to-f(x) now crosses a validated declared extension boundary, compiles role-complete function-wrap motif authority, survives plain-data catalogue copies without globals, rejects undeclared visual inference, and preserves exact current frames and focused browser behavior.

slices.title: Apply-log-cutover
slices.summary: Apply-log now invokes one shared typed function-wrap protocol twice under synchronized authority, supports explicit paired or absent enclosures, preserves exact current semantic/timing/frame behavior, and records the unchanged pre-existing collision separately without visual tuning.

slices.title: Log-product-composition-cutover
slices.summary: Log-product target branches now invoke the shared typed function-wrap protocol; manual reception construction was removed without visual changes.

slices.title: Log-quotient-composition-cutover
slices.summary: Log-quotient declares nominal function-wrap authority while preserving its distinct fusion recipe and exact presentation.

slices.title: Data-owned-tree-traversal
slices.summary: Structured equations now use family-owned traversal and projection protocols; synthetic kinds extend without walker edits.
